Hi Rasha,

Lots of people might be able to help you. I might be able to help you. But it's hard to be sure if I don't know what the problem is.

You should post your problem here - try to break it down, so that if you have multiple problems, just post one of them. Try to make it reproducible so someone can run your code (assuming you have code) and see what the problem is.

If you do this, and someone solves your problem, it then enters into the record, so the next person with a similar problem might be able to find your problem and the solution and use that information.

Jeremy
